snippet.title: Bloodgrounds | 1.0 Full Release - Coming March 12 !
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2507820/Bloodgrounds/
Together with another update full of content, mechanics, additions and tweaks Bloodgrounds will reach its 1.0 Release on March 12th !

Bloodgrounds merges tactical turn-based combat with strategic management layers and includes RPG and roguelite elements. Forged in the pits of the arena you fought your way out of slavery, now as a wealthy patron you recruit, train, and command your team of hardened Gladiators to glory - or death.
